newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gen to supply Palo Alto, Calif. electricity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gen to supply Palo Alto, Calif. electricity.

text.p: U.S. Generating Co (USGen), a joint venture of PG&E Corp and Bechtel Enterprises Inc, announced Wednesday an agreement to supply electricity and other energy services to Palo Alto, Calif.'s municipal utility.

USGen's power marketing affiliate, USGen Power Services, L.P., will procure a portion of Palo Alto's 1997-98 winter electricity requirements and will assist in managing wholesale electricity transactions.
The two parties said in a statement they will also share information and work together to optimize Palo Alto's power supply assets, such as transmission rights and purchase contracts.
Palo Alto is a muncipality serving 60,000 customers south of San Francisco.
USGen, which will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of PG&E by year-end, is a national power company.
